info.description: Formålet med gjennomføringsprosjektet er å etablere og tilgjengeliggjøre én kilde til strukturert legemiddelinformasjon for kravområdene Datakvalitet, Virkestoffordinering, Produktkoder, og Ernæring, Kobling mellom substans og ATC-kode og formidling av H-reseptinformasjon.

tags.name: Conformance
tags.description: The Conformance/Capability Statement documents a set of capabilities (behaviors) of the FHIR Server or Client for a particular version of FHIR that may be used as a statement of actual server functionality or a statement of required or desired server implementation.

tags.name: MedicinalProduct
tags.description: A medicinal product, being a substance or combination of substances that is intended to treat, prevent or diagnose a disease, or to restore, correct or modify physiological functions by exerting a pharmacological, immunological or metabolic action. This resource is intended to define and detail such products and their properties, for uses other than direct patient care (e.g. regulatory use, or drug catalogs).

tags.name: MedicinalProductPackaged
tags.description: A medically related item or items of any type, in a container or package, representing the unit that has been prepared for sale, supply, shipping or storage.

tags.name: MedicinalProductManufactured
tags.description: The definition and characteristics of a medicinal manufactured item, such as a tablet or capsule, as contained in a packaged medicinal product.

tags.name: MedicinalProductPharmaceutical
tags.description: A medicinal product in the final form which is suitable for administering to a patient (after any mixing of multiple components, dissolution etc. has been performed).

tags.name: MedicinalProductIngredient
tags.description: An ingredient of a manufactured item or pharmaceutical product.

tags.name: SubstanceSpecification
tags.description: The detailed description of a substance.

tags.name: Substance
tags.description: Nutrients in an enteral nutritional product (Nutrition Product) are represented through the field nutrient, which contains a reference to the FHIR resource Substance. Substance further refers to substances in the substance registry (SubstanceDefinition).

tags.name: NutritionProduct
tags.description: A food or supplement that is consumed by patients. The Nutrition Product resource does not exist in FHIR R4. As such is adopted into the Basic resource in SAFEST, but made accessible through the /NutritionProduct endpoint

tags.name: Basic
tags.description: Basic covers the ressources in SAFEST not yet defined in the FHIR standard. Such as NutritionProduct in FHIR R4

tags.name: ValueSet
tags.description: Specifies a set of codes drawn from one or more code systems, intended for use in a particular context. Value sets link between CodeSystem definitions and their use in coded elements.

tags.name: CodeSystem
tags.description: The CodeSystem resource is used to declare the existence of and describe a code system or code system supplement and its key properties, and optionally define a part or all of its content.

tags.name: ActivityDefinition
tags.description:
⚠️ Note: This FHIR resource is under development and is not production ready. Please refer to the H-resept project.

ActivityDefinition contains a description of an activity to be performed. It is used to specify actions determined by the Plan Definition, to be performed as part of a decision support workflow

tags.name: PlanDefinition
tags.description:
⚠️ Note: This FHIR resource is under development and is not production ready. Please refer to the H-resept project.

PlanDefinition is a resource with predefined groups of actions to be performed under specific circumstances, often including conditional elements, options, and other decision points. The resource is flexible enough to be used to represent a variety of workflows, such as clinical decision support. Plan Definition contains hierarchical groups of action definitions, which describe an activity to be performed. The activities are defined by the Activity Definition resource described in Activity Definition

tags.name: MedicinalProductAuthorization
tags.description:
⚠️ Note: This FHIR resource is under development and is not production ready. Please refer to the H-resept project.

MedicinalProductAuthorization is a resource for regulatory approval, clearance or licencing related to a regulated product, treatment, facility or activity that is cited in a guidance, regulation, rule or legislative act. An example is Market Authorization relating to a Medicinal Product.
